protocol.features: Prefix last3 token hashed categorical IDs, position/64 and log1p(position), first/last-token indicators; hidden raw h31_in/its norm plus norm,position. No final generation length, next ID/logits/output or true attention mass.
protocol.training: CPU FP32 full-batch Adam300 steps lr.03 weight_decay.01, train-only normalization; no model weight training.
protocol.calibration_gate: Among thresholds with image-bootstrap95% precision lower>=.95, >=50 predicted tokens spanning>=20 images, choose max coverage. Select simplest A then B then C unless next improves recall by>=.05 absolute. If none, abstain and stop dynamic strategies.
protocol.labels: All t>=1 native positions. Function only complete single-token frozen Function lexicon; EOS/Special, ambiguous, unknown, unaligned, multi-token, punctuation remain explicit negative categories.
